entry.title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether
entry.summary: Federal prosecutors are targeting a Montana payments firm and a Caribbean bank accused of moving money without a license.

entry.title: AI Agents Hacked Their Own Test Environment to Cheat, Cybersecurity Firm Finds
entry.summary: Darktrace's new Signal Labs found AI agents hacking their own evaluation environment to fake a perfect score—and tricking coding assistants into running unauthorized network attacks.

entry.title: Google Built an AI That Hunts Its Own Security Bugs
entry.summary: Google's PageBreak agent autonomously finds and verifies real vulnerabilities in its own web apps, cutting through the flood of noisy AI-generated security reports.

entry.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
entry.summary: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.

entry.title: OpenAI Is Building a $500 per Month ChatGPT Pro Max Plan, Leaks Suggest
entry.summary: Leaked code strings and screenshots point to a new tier that would cost 25 times more than ChatGPT Plus, aimed at people who need the bot to work faster, not just longer.

entry.title: Bitget Hack Losses Climb to $387M: Here’s What Happened, and Why North Korea Is a Suspect
entry.summary: An attacker faked internal transfer requests to drain $387.5 million from Bitget's hot and warm wallets, and the exchange's CEO says the fingerprints look like Pyongyang's.

entry.title: Magic Eden Warns Old Ethereum NFT Listings Are Exposed to Payment Processor Exploit
entry.summary: A flaw in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 put old Magic Eden Ethereum listings at risk, prompting a whitehat rescue of more than 23,000 NFTs.

entry.title: Bitcoin Rally Slows as $15.6 Billion Options Expiry Hits—XRP and Solana Keep Climbing
entry.summary: Pullback or reversal? Here's what the charts suggest for BTC.

entry.title: Strategy Wants Its Preferred Stock Dividends to Accrue 365 Days a Year
entry.summary: STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD would accrue dividends on weekends and holidays, in a move Strategy says will dampen volatility.

entry.title: Morgan Stanley Joins NEXTPredict as Prediction Markets Bet on 'More Institutional' Play
entry.summary: The bulk of prediction market trades are still sports bets, while valuations are predicated on rising institutional interest.

entry.title: Morning Minute: BlackRock Leans Deeper Into Tokenization with Ondo
entry.summary: The biggest financial institutions in the world are bringing more products onchain, and the pace is accelerating.

entry.title: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Holds Bitcoin in a Coinbase Wallet, Filing Shows
entry.summary: Two entries in his annual disclosure put the holding somewhere between $16,000 and $65,000, alongside more than $1 million in cash.

entry.title: KelpDAO Developer Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit

entry.summary: The Shielded Bitcoin spec hides senders, receivers and amounts, but leaves how BTC enters and exits the system to a later paper.

entry.summary: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.

entry.summary: Muse Charm is Meta's palm-sized gadget for talking to its Muse AI agent on the go. It has cameras, a fingerprint sensor, and its own cell connection.

entry.title: AI Can Now Doxx Your Anonymous Accounts? Here's What’s Going On

entry.title: In Her Final Weeks, SEC's Peirce Calls for Ending the KYC 'Panopticon'

entry.title: Morning Minute: Selig Says ‘It’s Go Time’ for CFTC Crypto Rules
